lg_LT_Rule:
Event Time:
Death Challenge: From 18:00-23:00 every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Endurance Challenge: From 9:00-23:50 every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday.
Conditions: Meet the required level and pay the entry fee. A player who announces a challenge can receive a bonus equal to 50% of the entry fee.
Reward Settings: The final winner of the Death Challenge can get all the rewards in the jackpot, and the winner of each Endurance Challenge can claim a reward equal to 50% of the entry fee. Rewards can accumulate. The final winner can also take all the rewards from the jackpot.
Special: The rewards in the package are random.
Death Challenge: If a player who holds the challenge manages to survive for half an hour, this player will become the winner of the challenge.
When the host is offline, rewards can also be claimed using the claim reward button (not accumulative).

lg_TaskTalk100010:
Now that you have the basic mindset of a ninja of the world, it's time to test your ability.
Now go to the Smelting Mountains and kill Sunflowers to begin your journey. We can't go on like this. Do you want to catch Sunflowers?
lg_TaskTalk100020: Becoming a ninja is not easy. You need to train and take part in keeping the village at peace. Go and meet the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>now.
lg_TaskTalk100030: Even though we sent people, the<font color='#00b034'> Sunflower </font>calamity continues in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>. The<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>outpost has asked the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>for help. Go now and help keep the peace in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100040: <font color='#00b034'>Stinger Bees </font>are the hardest to deal with. So many people have been stung already, and to fight them we need to get their stingers. Help me collect some<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100041: Thank you for getting the<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>. Now I can treat the many suffering travelers.
lg_TaskTalk100050: Thanks to the efforts of the guards, the<font color='#00b034'> Stinger Bees </font>no longer pose a threat to travelers. Return to the village and give the good news to the<font color='#00b034'> Jounin</font>!
lg_TaskTalk100051: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>clearly didn't pick the wrong person. Your performance on your first quest was excellent, keep working hard.
lg_TaskTalk100060:
With the crisis over, the Village Elder has decided to hold a banquet to celebrate.
Speaking of banquets, we can't leave out sushi, the finest delicacy in all of the Sakura Plains. Just thinking about it makes my mouth water. But for unknown reasons, the Sushi Monsters have stopped producing sushi. Woe to us if we have to live without sushi!
You must find the Sushi Monsters in the Smelting Mountains and get delicious sushi from them for the banquet. This is an important quest, and I trust you won't let me down.
lg_TaskTalk100061: Ahhh! Here it is! The luxurious<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>! Just its aroma is enough to make a grown man cry tears of joy! To taste such a heavenly delicacy, the villagers will be delighted.
lg_TaskTalk100070: You got the<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>. Now tell the villagers to join the banquet, the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>has been waiting in the hall.
lg_TaskTalk100080:
A series of disturbances has occurred in the Smelting Mountains recently, and it turns out it's not only in the Smelting Mountains. Many disturbances have also happened in the Sakura Plains. All of them are connected to one another.
To confirm the truth, I sent a Genin to investigate in each area. The time to report has come, but the Genin still hasn't arrived. Perhaps he ran into trouble on the road.
Now I need to send an envoy to the Smelting Mountains to investigate, and the Jounin recommended you. This quest is very important, you must give it your best effort.
lg_TaskTalk100090:
After I gathered information, I was attacked on the way home by a group calling themselves the Scarlet gang. So I had to hide here.
Only by wiping out these bandits can we return to the village safely.
lg_TaskTalk100091: The bandit group seems to be taking instructions from someone else to chase me this far. Good riddance.
lg_TaskTalk100100:
You, sent by the Village Elder, must be the scout. Because I was ambushed by bandits, to keep the information from falling into their hands, I let my clever ninja dog escape with it.
Find the ninja dog, and you will have the information.
lg_TaskTalk100110: Woof! Woof! So my master sent you to get the information from me. Clever<font color='#00b034'> Pakkun </font>never loses anything important.
lg_TaskTalk100111: So the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>was kidnapped by bandits. Thanks to you coming in time, we managed to get the<font color='#00b034'> Recon Scroll</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100120:
It turns out someone is coordinating all these events behind the scenes. The Genin even mentioned that the demons in the Smelting Mountains may be uniting to attack the village.
To prevent this, I have decided to send an elite platoon of guards to hold back the demons. You have proven your performance to be excellent, so you must join this quest.
lg_TaskTalk100131: <font color='#00b034'>Pakkun </font>found a suspicious man in black appearing in the place where the demons gather, and quietly observed his actions.
lg_TaskTalk100140: <font color='#00b034'>Pakkun </font>learned that the demons are being ordered by a man in black to attack the villagers. We will uncover many secrets if we capture that man.
lg_TaskTalk100151: He is the prodigy of the<font color='#00b034'> Wind Village</font>, the one who always seized the top position in every trial. The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>respected him greatly and sent him to<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>for special training. Soon after, he left<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>and vanished, and now we find that he is the mastermind behind all the demon chaos.
lg_TaskTalk100160: I think he is the mastermind behind the demons' evil deeds. This must be reported to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder</font>, you must return to the village now.
lg_TaskTalk100171: He was one of the ninja sent to<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>. I don't want him to give in to the temptation of darkness.
lg_TaskTalk100180:
It's time to head to Angel City for another selection of elite ninja. Recently, in the Eventide Barrens, Potato Demons have been stealing crops from the villagers. To protect the winter harvest, this must be resolved.
If you can get rid of the thieving Potato Demons, you will pass the trial and qualify to take part in the training in Angel City. Of course, Potato Demons are not like the monsters you've defeated so far, so don't rush in unless you're sure you can win.
lg_TaskTalk100181: Excellent, you have proven your courage through your actions. Congratulations on passing the trial. There is still some time before you leave for<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>. I hope you will continue your training during this period, and become the best at facing your future challenges!
lg_TaskTalk100190: Ah yes, the<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>seems to be having some trouble, why don't you help him when you're free.
lg_TaskTalk100191: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>asked you to come, that's great. I was at a loss as to whom to ask for help.
lg_TaskTalk100200: It's like this: the supplier regularly sends a<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant</font>, but it has been several days past the last scheduled delivery and the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>still hasn't arrived. I'm worried he ran into trouble on the way. Could you go out and see if he's all right?
lg_TaskTalk100201: The<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>asked for your help? That's great! Help me teach those damn monkeys a lesson.
lg_TaskTalk100220: The world is in chaos right now. The whole country is troubled by demons and evil creatures. I just heard that the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>are occupied by a group of<font color='#00b034'> Scarlet </font>bandits. If my goods are robbed by them, my business will go bankrupt. Can you deal with the bandits and escort me to the<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village </font>at the same time?
lg_TaskTalk100230: The ninja undergoing special training in<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>will be moving. I remember that you were among them. Quickly report to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100240:
Ninja taking part in the special training must go to the Crossroads area of Angel City to report to Master Yuan. I took part in the special training once, but I failed the final exam and was sent back to the Fire Village. I still learned a lot during the training period. Ah, how glorious that was!
Ah yes, I'd like to send some gifts to Master Yuan. Can you help me get Golden Honey and Pearly Riceballs?
lg_TaskTalk100241: The quality of the<font color='#00b034'> Golden Honey </font>and<font color='#00b034'> Pearly Riceballs </font>you obtained is excellent. I can use these to make good<font color='#00b034'> Honeydew Riceballs</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100250: Open the [World Map], choose<font color='#00b034'> Crossroads </font>and click to enter the<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>zone. Quickly report to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100251:
I am Master Yuan, in charge of the special ninja training in Angel City.
So this is the gift from the Fire Village that the Genin asked you to bring me. I remember now, that nimble young woman, a good kid. It's a pity her physical condition wasn't good enough to endure the heavy training.
lg_TaskTalk100300: Even if you weren't looking for it, you're still effective at your work. It was my mistake to underestimate you. Now report to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>.
lg_TaskTalk100330: I heard the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>ran into a problem.<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>wants you to go to the<font color='#00b034'> Eventide Barrens </font>to help him, you can go now.
lg_TaskTalk100331: You're the ninja<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>sent? You don't look very strong, hmmm. I guess we'll just have to rely on you!
lg_TaskTalk100350: You truly are a ninja from<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>. You should thank<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100380:
To rebuild their homes, we first need a stable food supply. We can rely on everyone's help to stave off the temporary food shortage, but it would be best to get plants suitable for farming.
On the Fiery Ridge lives a demon called Corn Demon . It likes to eat all kinds of food. Defeat it to get premium Rice Dumplings . Planting these cakes will yield a harvest in a short time. The villagers won't need to worry about food if we get these Rice Dumplings .
lg_TaskTalk100381: We have enough<font color='#00b034'> Rice Dumplings </font>, the villagers don't need to worry about food anymore!
lg_TaskTalk100400: I heard the<font color='#00b034'> Fiery Ridge </font>bandits are camped in the<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village </font>. Investigate the place and see what you can find.
lg_TaskTalk100410:
So the bandits were defeated by you, that's good news.
Although I don't know where the Knights gather in their hideout, I know how they behave at the Fiery Ridge. Their Digrats are in the back to loot valuables, attack the Digrats to find the bandits' treasure.
lg_TaskTalk100420: The villagers have started rebuilding their village. You can report this to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>.
lg_TaskTalk100431: What a surprise that<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>recommended you for this quest. It seems you have earned his approval.
lg_TaskTalk100440:
It seems demons have appeared near Angel City . Go and investigate.
The first report came from the Merchant Boss . Find him and ask for the details.
lg_TaskTalk100460:
You already know about the [Demon Sealing War] that shook the land 300 years ago. In the end, Demon Ieyasu and his minions were sealed in Demon City , and Angel City and the ninja of the various villages were assigned to guard the seal that suppresses the aura of Demon City .
Everything you have faced may be demons that escaped from Demon City . Go to the Eerie Passage now and learn more about the demons' activities from the Secret Tunnel Guard garrisoned there.
lg_TaskTalk100500: With the seal of<font color='#00b034'> Demon City </font>getting worse, I am worried about the other seals too. Go to the<font color='#00b034'> Fiery Ridge </font>area of<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village </font>and scout the situation there, then Report to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>.
lg_TaskTalk100510: I will Report the<font color='#00b034'> Scorching Demon </font>problem to the<font color='#00b034'> Ninja Chief </font>. There is something I want you to look into, a strange rumor going around the surface of<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>. For the details, look for<font color='#00b034'> Feng </font>.
lg_TaskTalk100520: According to the companions of the missing people, they heard a drum rhythm before they vanished. But no one had ever heard it before, so they thought it was a mistake by the missing. This must be an important clue. Report this to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>as soon as possible. We will also strictly protect the travelers nearby.
lg_TaskTalk100530: I remember now. 300 years ago, Demon Ieyasu had seven demons under him, the [Seven Demons]. One of them, the <font color='#00b034'> Demon of Souls </font>, was skilled at using the charm of drums on the heart.
lg_TaskTalk100540: As a precaution, we must first prepare measures against the drum demon. In ancient history, the <font color='#00b034'> Demon of Souls </font> is said to hate the scent of candles molded from <font color='#00b034'> Demon Toad Oil </font>.<font color='#00b034'> Demon Toad Oil </font>can be found on the<font color='#00b034'> Green Frogs </font>of the<font color='#00b034'> Crossroads </font>. Go look for it now.
lg_TaskTalk100541: That's right, this is<font color='#00b034'> Demon Toad Oil </font>, just as Scholar Han described.
lg_TaskTalk100550:
Now that we have some Demon Toad Oil , I can mold the candle.
Wait a moment.
lg_TaskTalk100551: This is the<font color='#00b034'> Demon of Souls </font>' sworn enemy, the<font color='#00b034'> Exorcizing Candle </font>. Keep it safe.
lg_TaskTalk100560: If the rumor is true and Demon Ieyasu is the<font color='#00b034'> Demon of Souls </font>, then using this candle should make his power vanish.
lg_TaskTalk100590:
Thinking about Demon City . It seems they are scattering and trying to destroy the seals all over Sakura Land .
The most important thing now is to notify every ninja village. Return to Fire Village now and inform the Village Elder .
lg_TaskTalk100600: The<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant</font> who delivers supplies regularly has been wandering all over the mainland. His information is the most accurate. You can ask whether he knows anything about the rumors.
lg_TaskTalk100610:
What sincerity? We merchants are only motivated by profit. If you want information, you must hand over something of equal value.
Have you heard of the River God's Pearl? It is a precious artifact, but it is heavily guarded by the Kappa. Bring me the River God's Pearl, and I will tell you what you want to know. Sounds fair?
lg_TaskTalk100620:

lg_TipDes_Debris453_itemname:
Locks one pet skill so a new skill cannot replace it.
Usage: in the Pet Kennel, click Lock next to a skill.
Locking a pet's first skill uses 1 lock. Locking its second skill uses 2. A pet can have 2 locked skills.
lg_TipDes_Debris2027_itemname:
Removes one skill from your pet.
Usage: in the Pet Kennel, click Remove next to the skill.
